Source src/website/components/portfolio/related/types.ts
UX surface Boot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

(module scope)

A related-projects pointer row — link/page identify the target, featured promotes it visually; title/image/description are hydrated from the home portfoliolist since the related node stores pointers only.

(module scope)

A social row in the related footer — network names the service (icon lookup key), link is the profile URL.

(module scope)

The components/related DB node as consumed by — projects may arrive keyed-object or array from Firebase, path is the portfolio base route, socials/note/title the footer copy.

(module scope)

A home portfoliolist row used to hydrate related pointers — link is the join key, image/label/title/description fill the card.

(module scope)

The resolved display card — every field concrete (no optionals) because hydration already merged the pointer row with its home-list data. fullPath is the computed route to the project page.
